mechanism_claims.claim_text: NCP-3 is supported as causing rapid inner-membrane permeabilization in the propidium iodide assay.
direct_assay_types: propidium iodide dead-cell membrane permeabilization assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: The claim is limited to the reported assay target and concentration context; it is not generalized to all NCP variants or all organisms.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: NCP-2 and NCP-3 are supported as permeabilizing bacterial membranes, with NCP-3 showing stronger outer- and inner-membrane lytic action in the ONPG/CENTA assay context.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: NCP-2 and NCP-3 on Escherichia coli ML-35 pYC
mechanism_claims.limitations: The source supports membrane permeabilization; it does not require a single pore model for every peptide-target pair.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CD/model-vesicle evidence supports interaction with bacterial-membrane-mimicking vesicles and weaker ordered-structure formation in neutral eukaryotic-membrane-mimicking vesicles.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: NCP-0, NCP-2, and NCP-3 in model vesicles
mechanism_claims.limitations: Model-vesicle structure evidence is retained as context and is not promoted above the direct permeabilization assays.
